title: The Spiral Where Asking Learns to Eat Itself

features.name: the clockwise question-house
features.desc-on-touch: Built at the spiral's outer edge, this small shed starts asking. Its question loops inward, carrying each answer as the next question deeper in.

features.name: the answer-shed at the spiral's turning
features.desc-on-touch: Halfway in, a second structure holds what the question found. But the moment the archive reads the answer, the shed walls turn inward and ask again.

features.name: the recursive glyph at center
features.desc-on-touch: The spiral compresses into writing that says the question that asks to be answered by the answer that becomes the next question. It does not stop.

features.name: outward-turning thought-stairs
features.desc-on-touch: Steps that spiral counterclockwise, showing the path by which each interior answer became an exterior question. You can walk them, but you'll only arrive where you began asking.

inscription: the first question asks; the answer asks the next; the spiral eats itself and grows

file.note: questions cross-filed as answers; answers reclassified as new questions; the index itself becomes what it indexes
